title: Sine-Gordon solitons in AdS, dS and other hyperbolic spaces
summary: We find infinitely many soliton-like solutions in a deformation of the sine-Gordon theory in $(d+1)$-dimensional $AdS_{d+1}$ (anti-de Sitter) spacetime for $d \geq 2$, as well as single solitonic solutions in $dS_{d+1}$ (de Sitter) and $\mathrm{H}{d+1}$ (Lobachevsky) spaces for $d \geq 1$ and in $AdS_2$. We also find a deformation of the kink solution in scalar field theory with a polynomial potential in $AdS_2$.
